create_svm_weighted_classification: create an SVC classifier with sample weights to emphasize positive class points
plot_decision_function_weighted: plot a decision function with scatter points sized by sample weight
generate_classification_dataset: generate a synthetic classification dataset with imbalanced class weights
display_decision_boundary: display a classifier decision boundary using DecisionBoundaryDisplay.from_estimator
fit_svm_with_sample_weights: fit an SVC model with custom sample weights to rescale C per sample
